cases.name: image assets loads correctly
cases.note: Imports walle.riv, resolves each named live Image referencer to its ImageAsset owner, proves exact byte sizes and shared/distinct owner identity, then performs updateComponents and draw.

adaptation.rationale: Stable retained FileAsset global identities preserve C++ ImageAsset pointer equality without exposing raw pointers.
adaptation.inapplicable_observable: Only the raw C++ ImageAsset pointer address is excluded; exact referencer-to-owner sharing, inequality, encoded byte size, decode, update, and draw remain asserted.

cases.name: out of band image assets loads correctly
cases.note: Imports the exact out-of-band fixture, attaches the exact external files to their authored asset identities, proves byte sizes and shared/distinct ImageAsset ownership, then performs updateComponents and draw.

adaptation.rationale: Stable retained FileAsset global identities preserve C++ ImageAsset pointer equality without exposing raw pointers.
adaptation.inapplicable_observable: Only the raw C++ ImageAsset pointer address is excluded; exact referencer-to-owner sharing, inequality, external byte size, decode, update, and draw remain asserted.

cases.name: png file decodes correctly
cases.note: Reads the exact 1,096-byte PNG and asserts successful decode, dimensions, channel rule, and decoded byte count.

cases.name: jpeg file decodes correctly
cases.note: Reads the exact 8,880-byte JPEG and asserts successful decode, dimensions, channel rule, and decoded byte count.

cases.name: bad jpeg file doesn't cause an overflow
cases.note: Executes the exact non-Apple branch against the pinned 88,731-byte malformed JPEG and reaches the decoder-result seam before any oversized allocation.
cases.expected_red_reason: expected-red: pinned non-Apple decoder returns the 24566x58278 bad JPEG bitmap, while Rust rejects it before oversized allocation

cases.name: bad png file doesn't cause an overflow
cases.note: Reads the exact 534,283-byte malformed PNG and executes the pinned platform branch; macOS reaches the divergent successful-black-bitmap result while non-Apple retains the exact null assertion.
cases.expected_red_reason: expected-red: pinned Apple decoder returns the 58278x24566 bad PNG bitmap, while Rust rejects it before oversized allocation

cases.name: webp file decodes correctly
cases.note: Reads the exact 30,320-byte WebP and asserts successful decode, dimensions, and exact four-channel byte count.
